summary:

2. Key Files: src/billing/invoice.ts (settleDowngrade — removed the double negation so the credit applies with the right sign), src/billing/rounding.ts (shared round helper, unchanged).
3. Errors: one failing assertion on the credit sign after the first edit; resolved by fixing the call site above.
4. Commands: npm test -- proration (14 passing).
5. Next: none pending.
